EURECOM, based in the Sophia Antipolis technology park near Nice, runs graduate programmes in digital science — AI, cybersecurity, telecommunications and data — plus doctoral studies with its labs and industrial partners. Its admission portal manages both taught-programme rounds and rolling PhD recruitment.

Programme Highlights

  • Specialised digital-science graduate school with strong industry links
  • PhD contracts funded through labs and partner companies
  • Merit tuition waivers for competitive applicants
  • French Riviera location with European tech-ecosystem access

Who Should Apply

Engineering and computer-science graduates targeting AI, security, networking and data specialisations.

Funding and Costs

Merit-based tuition waivers and lab-funded PhD contracts; details per programme on the admission portal. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Create an account on the EURECOM admission portal, choose your programme, and follow the round dates and document checklist shown there. Key deadline information: Rolling PhD admissions; taught-programme rounds close per the admission portal for each intake.
